convention: abs(P_sim/P_HMcode-1) <= 0.05 in every retained existing bin
caveats: Descriptive agreement, not HMcode calibration or simulation convergence.
Intervals are runs of adjacent existing bins, not an interpolated crossing or guaranteed continuous function.
A terminal interval has all bins passing through the last available bin of the stated window.
All runs, including isolated bins, are retained in JSON; a single bin is not an extended interval.
No official masks changed, no data corrected, no new simulation, plot, PDF or website update.
Higher-k results remain subject to assignment/aliasing, force/particle resolution and model extrapolation.
